notes.title: The main game, Penguin Hotel, is now free!
notes.notes: Chapter 2 launches on March 28. Be sure to check it out!

notes.title: "Penguin Hotel" Get Challenge
notes.notes:
Giveaway: "Penguin Hotel" for the Top 8 in the Time Attack Ranking
If you already own "Penguin Hotel," you will receive "Penguin Hotel 2" for free upon release.

Overview
The ranking will be finalized on February 28 at 9:00 PM (JST).
The results will be announced on Discord.
How to Check the Ranking
Open Steam Achievements > Global Ranking.
Added vertical sync option. Enabling this can reduce noise on the screen.

notes.title: "Get 'Penguin Hotel' in a Time Attack Challenge!"
notes.notes:
Players who rank 8th, 18th, 28th, 38th, 48th, 58th, 68th, 78th, 88th, or 98th in the Time Attack leaderboard will receive the full version of Penguin Hotel!

The final ranking will be confirmed on February 18th at 8 PM JST.

Important:
Winners will be announced on the official Discord server, so make sure to join if you wish to participate!

If you already own Penguin Hotel, you will receive Penguin Hotel 2 on its release day instead.
